slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: items
slots.about: the things to read: id, title, by (who made it), meta (a short line such as a length), published (a date), picture (an image source or blank), read and saved (true or false)

slots.name: head_text
slots.about: the line over the top item

slots.name: new_word
slots.about: the word after the count of unread items, e.g. new

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is nothing to read

slots.name: read_event
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens an item and marks it read

slots.name: save_event
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: saves an item, a second tap lets it go

empty.shows: empty; the head, the top card and the list hide

fallback.shows: no picture: the top card is text only, a row shows the maker's initial on a tile

attention.shows: the unread count beside the head; a read title turns secondary

labels.save: save_event.label (the sample says Save and the title)

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap
